description: This file defines a custom exception class `ValidatorException` within the `OrangeHRM` HRM system. It extends the standard PHP `Exception` class, adding a default error message and supporting previous exception chaining.

classes.name: ValidatorException
classes.description: A custom exception class for validation errors within the OrangeHRM API v2 plugin.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a ValidatorException with an optional custom message, code, and previous exception.
